# Method IsExplicit

#### IsExplicit(DocumentId)

Tells whether a family document is an explicit family document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 10, 0, 0)]
bool IsExplicit(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the family document to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  The family is an explicit family.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.10.
